BEFORE YOU HIT THE ROAD

A few things
you might ask.

Let’s plan your trip ↗
Can I book a one-way drop taxi?

Yes. Choose your pickup city, destination and travel date to prepare a one-way trip request. You do not need to plan a return trip.

Which locations do you cover?

Our service is for journeys across Tamil Nadu. You can enter any town or city, even if it is not listed in the suggestions. Availability is confirmed for your specific route.

How is my fare confirmed?

Your final quote depends on the route, vehicle and travel schedule. Confirm the total fare, driver allowance, tolls, parking and any other applicable charges with the booking team before accepting a trip.

Is my trip confirmed when I fill in the form?

No. The form prepares your trip details. A booking is confirmed only after the team agrees on availability, pickup details and the final fare with you.
